(* REQ: LANG-751 LANG-752 LANG-753 LANG-754 *)
MODULE Greeter;
  IMPORT Out;

  (* outer (* nested *) still a comment *)
  CONST Max = 10;

  TYPE Point = RECORD x, y: INTEGER END;

  VAR i: INTEGER; done: BOOLEAN;

  PROCEDURE Square(x: INTEGER): INTEGER;
  BEGIN
    RETURN x * x
  END Square;

BEGIN
  done := FALSE;
  FOR i := 1 TO Max DO
    IF (i MOD 2 = 0) & ~done THEN
      Out.String("Hello, world"); Out.Int(Square(i), 4); Out.Ln
    END
  END;
  INC(i); ASSERT(i > 0); done := TRUE
END Greeter.
